desc: 冷白光廊首屏与渐变酒红卡阵贯穿的家用理发器详情页套图
leaf: 家用精钢双环刀头电动理发器
name: 家用精钢双环刀头电动理发器款

shots.intent: 用无干扰白底直立机身在搜索页立住品类与刀头形态，做详情首屏的合规锚点
以仰视机身穿过白色光廊的气势画面承接首屏颜值与黑科技主张
shots.textZone: top-left kicker, two-line headline, one pill bar and one divider-separated feature line

shots.intent: 把功能主张拆成同规格渐变卡片矩阵，一眼扫完全部核心卖点
shots.textZone: centred headline and pill above the grid, one label inside each card

shots.intent: 用后颈实操背影与三枚人群徽标让家庭买家直接自我代入
shots.textZone: two-line headline at the top and three circular icon labels at the lower left

shots.intent: 微距替刀头工艺说话，圆角与钢面纹理直接证明打磨与装配水准
同框同光双卡对照刀面与刀网结构，让用料差异一眼可读
shots.textZone: two-line headline above the pair and one pill label per card

shots.intent: 用同尺寸同角度两幅热成像把旧刀头发热这一隐性痛点变成可见画面
shots.textZone: headline and note line above the plate, one caption card under each heat panel

shots.intent: 编号三段把刻度微调、按键手感与壳体接缝拆成可读的工艺证据
shots.textZone: centred headline and sub-line at the top, one title and one support line per number block, cards alternating left and right

shots.intent: 同规格三竖幅实操纪录加一条强调横条，用过程画面而非证书降低顾虑
shots.textZone: two-line headline above the frames and one short line inside the pill bar

shots.intent: 侧视立面加双栏参数表消除体积与配置疑虑，全部数值留占位待填
shots.textZone: dimension labels above and beside the product, six table rows beneath

shots.intent: 机身与定位梳家族同排陈列在强调场地上，用三枚短徽标和按钮收口
shots.textZone: two-line headline and three icon labels at the left, one pill button at the lower right

style.direction: clean clinical personal-care appliance ecommerce with a deep rose card system
style.iconSystem: white thin-line single-stroke icons inside #A63B54 gradient rounded cards or #A63B54 circles, hairline-numbered detail blocks 01 02 03, #A63B54 pill bars for labels and the CTA button, thin #2D2D2D dimension lines with arrow ends
style.lightingSystem: neutral soft studio key from the upper left at about 5600K with a thin rim tracing the anodised shell edge, constant soft contact shadow under every product and card, macro and blade screens switch to raking side light to reveal steel grain
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean clinical personal-care appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a cold white field #FFFFFF, a light grey plate #EDEEF0 and charcoal text #2D2D2D, with one deep rose accent #A63B54 and one soft rose secondary #D4707F; neutral soft studio key from the upper left at about 5600K with a thin rim on the anodised shell and a constant soft contact shadow under every product and card; modern geometric sans-serif with short Chinese copy wrapped in corner brackets and one thin rule under each headline; alternating #FFFFFF copy fields and #A63B54 gradient section fields, product screens inset into #FFFFFF rounded cards; white thin-line icons inside #A63B54 cards and circles, hairline-numbered detail blocks, #A63B54 pill bars and thin #2D2D2D dimension lines with arrow ends; one stable upright clipper silhouette with the blade head at the top, blade teeth and scale marks never renumbered, anodised and brushed-steel finishes rendered separately; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented spec numbers, no fake display UI.
noDrift: no invented spec numbers or ratings
no fake display UI on the body
style.presentationRules: one stable upright clipper silhouette with the blade head at the top across the whole set, consistent body scale and centred placement, blade teeth and micro-adjust scale marks shown exactly as supplied and never renumbered, anodised and brushed-steel finishes rendered separately, no restyling of the body or its trims
style.surfaceSystem: #FFFFFF technical plates and spec tables, #EDEEF0 comparison and heat panels, brushed steel blade faces and anodised metal body shells rendered as real material
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; #2D2D2D two-line Chinese headlines on light plates and #FFFFFF headlines on #A63B54 fields, one thin #FFFFFF or #A63B54 rule under each headline, one hairline kicker or right-aligned #6E6E6E label per screen, three-layer copy only, Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」
